reason: The attempt-1 capability census producer created its Vulkan instance without pApplicationInfo, so the loader provided Vulkan 1.0 semantics while the probe called Vulkan 1.1 core functionality (vkEnumeratePhysicalDeviceGroups, vkGetDeviceGroupPeerMemoryFeatures). Per the Vulkan specification an instance created without application info is a 1.0 instance. The resulting negative observations cannot establish that a different runtime is required; the census must be corrected before its results are interpretable.
